total_supply.meaning: ERC-20 totalSupply value used as the scaling denominator in share-minting and redemption formulas

ghost_shares.meaning: 1,000,000 shares included in totalSupply that are never minted to any account

sum_balances.meaning: sum of balanceOf[] over all accounts, the backed share total

assets_released_per_share.meaning: assets released per share on redemption, computed with totalSupply as denominator

fair_assets_per_share.meaning: fair pro-rata assets per share that redemption should release absent the inflated denominator

formulas_use_total_supply_flag.meaning: both key share-minting and redemption formulas use totalSupply as a scaling factor

assumptions: totalSupply is used as the scaling denominator in the redemption formula, so an inflated totalSupply lowers assets released per share.
The 1,000,000 ghost shares are counted in totalSupply but have no corresponding balances, so totalSupply exceeds sum(balanceOf[]).

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete numeric expected-versus-actual assets-per-share amounts, so fair_assets_per_share and assets_released_per_share remain symbolic.
Report does not state whether 1,000,000 ghost shares is a literal constructor value or illustrative; the bound is encoded as total_supply >= 1000000.

limitations: Only the withdrawal_underpays impact is formalized; deposit_overmints and value_skimmed_permanently are out of scope for this plan.
The relation is stated at the per-share asset level; no concrete asset amounts are supplied by the report.
